description: A Python script defines retrieved chunks and gold answers for five questions, then computes recall@1, recall@2, and recall@3 showing how many gold chunks appear in the top k results.

steps.description: The retrieved dictionary maps each question to a list of three document IDs ranked by the retriever, best match first.
The gold dictionary maps each question to the single document ID that a human marked as the correct answer.
The recall_at_k function computes the share of questions whose gold chunk appears in the top k retrieved chunks, using a list comprehension and mean.

steps.question: For Q1 with gold doc0 and retrieved [doc0, doc3, doc4], is the gold chunk in the top 1?

steps.description: The loop iterates k = 1, 2, 3, computes recall for each, and prints the score with the list of missed questions.
The loop runs and prints recall@1 = 0.40 missed Q3 Q4 Q5, recall@2 = 0.60 missed Q4 Q5, recall@3 = 0.80 missed Q5.

title: Computing Recall@k for Retrieval Evaluation
